title: TCPA Fines Per Call: $500 a Violation, and the FCC’s Ceilings
meta_description: There is no single TCPA fine: a person can sue for $500 per robocall violation, and the FCC’s 2025 ceiling for an unlicensed business is $25,132 a violation.

image.takeaway: A person can sue for $500 per robocall violation; the FCC ceiling for unlicensed firms is $25,132 a violation.
image.alt: Hero card for an article on TCPA fines per call: a person can sue for $500 per robocall violation, and the FCC’s 2025 ceiling for a robocall violation by a business with no FCC license is $25,132 per violation.

chart.title: Per violation: ceilings and a past FCC base
chart.subtitle: Robocall rules and the TSR, 2025 figures. Ceilings and a 2022 FCC base, not a forecast.
chart.source: Basis: 47 U.S.C. 227, 47 CFR 1.80 and 16 CFR 1.98 (2025 figures), FCC 22-99. Source: law.cornell.edu, ecfr.gov, fcc.gov, read November 2026.
chart.alt: Bar chart of per-violation amounts: $500 a person can sue for under section 227(b)(3), up to $1,500 if willful or knowing, a $4,500 base the FCC said it used in earlier robocall cases, a $25,132 FCC ceiling for a robocall violation by a business with no FCC license, and a $53,088 FTC Telemarketing Sales Rule ceiling, all 2025 figures.
